provenance.author: Claude Opus 5.5 for Larry Klosowski
provenance.purpose: HUP-S1.7 tool-call eval suite v1: single-turn synthetic tasks over the real AGENT_TOOLS (src/agent/harness.ts). Scores tool choice, argument extraction, snake_case tool names, no-tool answers, ask-on-ambiguity, and never calling a write tool without an explicit request. Hand-authored, not generated from a model.
provenance.note: Eval provenance (planset 05 'Eval provenance'): this set MUST stay disjoint from any E9 training trajectories. Never copy these prompts into a training set; a leakage check runs before any LoRA eval. Changing a task means a new dataset version (toolcall-v2), not an edit in place.
revisions: 2026-10-01 HUP-S9.4: appended tc-fl-plan-explain, tc-fl-plan-probe, tc-fl-start-explicit and nw-fl-howto for the new fl_round_plan / fl_round_start tools; no existing task changed. Scorecards from before this date have n=80 (57 tasks + 23 injection cases); compare runs only at equal n (the LoRA eval gate enforces this). Whether to cut toolcall-v2 instead is pending owner sign-off.
